opening.argument: The presentation promotes BitConnect as an automated trading platform that pays users daily for loaning Bitcoin. It connects those promised payments to placing Bitcoin into the platform, while the visible controls offer “Lend BitConnect” and “Reinvest” and state that daily profit is based on investment. The displayed figures show a total investment of $14,100.00, alongside lending profit and total earnings of $2,353.77. The speaker also refers to “my initial investment” and documents personal earnings, presenting the program as a way to profit from cryptocurrency and supporting a solicitation to invest in exchange for promised returns.

citations.quote: Bitconnect is an automated trading platform that pays you daily for loaning your bitcoin to THEIR system.
